app.title: Upgrade app
app.followUpFixes: When it is ready, chat will show the completed SDK upgrade.

app.newSince: This creates a new version of the app using the latest SDK. New since this version was built:
app.stale: This app uses an older SDK. Upgrading includes SDK fixes and compatibility updates.

app.legacy: This app was built on an older SDK that cannot report its exact capabilities. Upgrading creates a new version from the latest template.

aiAnalysisSettings.title: AI analysis
aiAnalysisSettings.description: Let viewers analyse what a data app shows and investigate notable data points.

aiOff.title: AI is not enabled
aiOff.body: AI analysis needs Ask AI enabled for the organization. Turn it on under <link>Ask AI · General</link>.

enable.name: AI analysis
enable.description: Lets viewers analyse the current view of any data app. Sends query results a viewer already has access to, to your configured AI provider.

auto.name: Analyse automatically on load
auto.description: Default for apps: run the analysis when a viewer opens an app, without a click. Stored analyses of identical results are reused.

continue.name: Continue investigations in Ask AI
continue.description: Lets viewers carry an investigation on as an Ask AI thread. The thread stays read-only. Off keeps viewers at the explanation.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Caps on how much AI analysis your organization can run. On Lightdash's AI key the daily caps cannot exceed {{analyses}} analyses and {{investigations}} investigations; on your own key they apply as set.
limits.required: Enter a value of 1 or more

dailyDetectCap.label: Analyses per day
dailyDetectCap.description: Model runs of the analysis across all apps and viewers in your organization per UTC day. Stored analyses of identical results are reused and do not count. Leave empty for no cap.

dailyInvestigateCap.label: Investigations per day
dailyInvestigateCap.description: Agent investigations across all apps and viewers in your organization per UTC day. Leave empty for no cap.

dailyPromptCap.label: Prompts per day
dailyPromptCap.description: Answers to in-app AI prompts across all apps and viewers in your organization per UTC day. Leave empty for no cap.

investigateMaxSteps.label: Maximum steps per investigation
investigateMaxSteps.description: Model steps the agent may take before it must answer.

investigateMaxWarehouseQueries.label: Maximum warehouse queries per investigation
investigateMaxWarehouseQueries.description: Queries the agent may run; when reached it explains what it found so far and the result is marked partial.

noBrowser.title: No headless browser is configured
noBrowser.body: Thumbnails are captured in a headless browser, and this instance does not have one. Automatic capture is skipped until one is configured.

thumbnails.title: Automatically capture thumbnails
thumbnails.description: Each data app version gets a thumbnail when it becomes ready, rendered as the user who created it. Text is blurred so values are not readable. Turning this off keeps existing thumbnails, and thumbnails can still be captured by hand.
